n: Control Port Expansion Module Compatible with any Crestron 2-Series (C2N-IO)
d: C2N-IO Control Port Expansion Module Compatible with any Crestron 2-Series, 3-Series®, or 4-Series® control system

specs.label: Cresnet® Network
specs.value: Cresnet client mode, 2-Series, 3-Series®, or 4-Series® control system compatible

specs.label: RS-232
specs.value: Supports 2-way device control and monitoring up to 115.2k baud with software; handshaking

specs.label: IR/Serial
specs.value: Supports 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.2 MHz or serial TTL/RS-232 (0-5 VDC) up to 115.2k baud

specs.label: Construction
specs.value: Metal, freestanding or surface mount, surface mount bracket and 3M® Dual Lock® reclosable fastener included, fits inside a 2-gang electrical box or 2-gang UK (BS 4662) electrical box

specs.label: Width
specs.value: 3.50 in. (89 mm), 4.38 in (112 mm) with bracket
